She also reported symmetrical inflammatory arthralgia with predominant involvement of the bilateral radiocarpal and patellofemoral joints, together with distal sensory loss affecting the distal third of both lower extremities.

panels.rationale: Renal biopsy HES light microscopy of a glomerulus showing the classic cryoglobulinemic glomerulonephritis pattern: membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis with diffuse endocapillary proliferation and mesangial hypercellularity, double-contour (tram-track) basement membrane duplication, and intraluminal hyaline thrombi (cryoglobulin pseudothrombi). The caption explicitly attributes these findings to cryoglobulinemic glomerulonephritis and the article title identifies Type I cryoglobulinemia with multiple myeloma, directly supporting the disease attribution. This is a real patient histology image with no third-party copyright. [raw subtype: Type I cryoglobulinemia]
